actions.description: Put an ingredient or prepared component into the pot, pan, bowl or dish.
actions.visualization: Ingredient being dropped or spooned into the vessel.

actions.description: Take an ingredient or component out (e.g. remove whole spices, remove from the pan or from the heat).
actions.visualization: Item lifted out of the vessel with tongs or a spoon.

actions.description: Pour a liquid or a liquid component into or over something.
actions.visualization: Liquid streaming from a jug or pan into the vessel.

actions.description: Move food to another vessel (e.g. to a baking dish, serving bowl or plate lined with paper towel).
actions.visualization: Food being moved from one vessel into another.

actions.description: Measure or weigh out an ingredient before using it.
actions.visualization: Ingredient in a measuring cup, spoon or on a scale.

actions.description: Split one ingredient or prepared mixture into portions (e.g. divide the dough into 8 balls). State the number of portions in the description.
actions.visualization: Mixture split into equal portions on the counter.

actions.description: Add salt, pepper or seasonings to taste. Ingredients are the seasonings; processes are what gets seasoned.
actions.visualization: Hand sprinkling seasoning over the food.

actions.description: Fill one food with another (e.g. stuff peppers, fill dumplings or parathas).
actions.visualization: Filling being spooned into a hollow vegetable or wrapper.

actions.description: Build layers or top a dish with components (e.g. biryani, lasagna, pizza toppings).
actions.visualization: Cross-section of stacked layers in a dish.

actions.description: Spread a soft ingredient or mixture evenly over a surface (e.g. butter on bread, sauce on a pizza base).
actions.visualization: Knife or spoon spreading an even layer.

actions.description: Thread pieces onto skewers (kebabs, satay, tikka).
actions.visualization: Pieces threaded along a skewer.

actions.description: Wrap or roll food in a wrapper, leaf or foil (wraps, spring rolls, parcels).
actions.visualization: Food being enclosed in a wrapper or foil.

actions.description: Turn food over so the other side cooks (pancakes, cutlets, steaks).
actions.visualization: Spatula flipping food in the pan, browned side up.

actions.description: Wash or rinse under water (rice, dal, vegetables, canned beans, or cooked pasta).
actions.visualization: Food under running water in a colander or bowl.

actions.description: Leave submerged in liquid to hydrate or soften (dal, beans, rice, saffron, dried chilies).
actions.visualization: Ingredient submerged in a bowl of water.

actions.description: Pour off liquid and keep the solids (pasta, soaked dal, canned beans, fried food on paper towels).
actions.visualization: Food in a colander with liquid running out.

actions.description: Remove skin, peel or shell (potatoes, garlic, eggs, shrimp, peas).
actions.visualization: Peeler or fingers removing the skin.

actions.description: Cut away ends, stems, fat or sinew.
actions.visualization: Knife trimming the ends off on a board.

actions.description: Remove the core (apples, pears, pineapple, cabbage, tomatoes).
actions.visualization: Core being cut out of the fruit.

actions.description: Remove seeds or pits (chilies, capsicum, tomatoes, dates, olives, cherries).
actions.visualization: Seeds being scraped out of a halved vegetable.

actions.description: Remove the dark vein from shrimp or prawns.
actions.visualization: Knife tip lifting the vein from a shrimp.

actions.description: Remove bones from meat, poultry or fish, or cut fish into fillets.
actions.visualization: Knife separating flesh from the bone.

actions.description: Prepare fish or seafood (gut, scale, clean squid) or brush clean mushrooms.
actions.visualization: Seafood being cleaned on a board.

actions.description: Cut into a named shape or size. Always give the preparation style (e.g. cubed, wedges, halved). Can also cut a prepared component (dough, cake).
actions.visualization: Knife cutting on a board; show the resulting shape.

actions.description: Chop into irregular pieces; use the style for fineness (finely / roughly).
actions.visualization: Pile of chopped pieces on a board.

actions.description: Cut into slices (onions, bread, roast meat, cake).
actions.visualization: Evenly sliced pieces fanned out.

actions.description: Cut into even cubes.
actions.visualization: Neat uniform cubes on a board.

actions.description: Chop very finely (garlic, ginger, herbs, shallots).
actions.visualization: Tiny minced pieces gathered on a board.

actions.description: Rub against a grater (cheese, ginger, carrot, coconut, nutmeg).
actions.visualization: Ingredient rubbed over a box grater.

actions.description: Cut or tear into thin strips or pieces (cabbage, lettuce, basil, cooked chicken, pulled pork).
actions.visualization: Thin strands or torn pieces.

actions.description: Crush or crumble (garlic, cardamom, pepper, biscuits, feta).
actions.visualization: Mortar and pestle or knife flat crushing the ingredient.

actions.description: Grind in a grinder or mortar into a powder or paste (spice mixes, masala paste, soaked dal batter).
actions.visualization: Grinder jar or mortar with powder or paste.

actions.description: Crush soft or cooked food into a mash (potatoes, bananas, cooked dal, avocado).
actions.visualization: Masher pressing into soft food in a bowl.

actions.description: Blend until smooth in a blender or food processor (soups, sauces, smoothies, chutneys).
actions.visualization: Blender jar with smooth purée.

actions.description: Crack open (eggs, nuts, whole pepper).
actions.visualization: Egg cracking over the rim of a bowl.

actions.description: Remove the coloured outer peel of citrus.
actions.visualization: Citrus rubbed over a fine zester.

actions.description: Squeeze out the juice (lemons, limes, oranges, tamarind pulp).
actions.visualization: Hand squeezing a halved citrus.

actions.description: Separate egg whites from yolks.
actions.visualization: Yolk held in a shell half over a bowl of whites.

actions.description: Flatten or tenderize with a mallet or rolling pin (chicken breast, cutlets).
actions.visualization: Mallet flattening meat between sheets.

actions.description: Make shallow cuts on the surface (fish, meat for marinade, bread dough).
actions.visualization: Shallow diagonal slashes on the surface.

actions.description: Combine ingredients or components until evenly distributed.
actions.visualization: Spoon mixing ingredients together in a bowl.

actions.description: Move food around with a spoon, usually while cooking so it does not stick; use repeat interval for "every few minutes".
actions.visualization: Spoon stirring food in a pan.

actions.description: Beat briskly with a whisk to combine or aerate (eggs, batters, dressings).
actions.visualization: Whisk moving through liquid in a bowl.

actions.description: Beat vigorously (eggs, or butter with sugar until light and fluffy).
actions.visualization: Mixer beaters in a bowl of pale fluffy mixture.

actions.description: Whip to incorporate air until peaks form (cream, egg whites, aquafaba).
actions.visualization: Glossy whipped peaks on a whisk.

actions.description: Gently combine with a spatula without knocking out air.
actions.visualization: Spatula folding a light mixture.

actions.description: Lift and turn to coat evenly (salads with dressing, pasta with sauce, vegetables with oil).
actions.visualization: Salad tossed with tongs in a large bowl.

actions.description: Combine fat and liquid into a stable emulsion (mayonnaise, vinaigrette, hollandaise).
actions.visualization: Thick, glossy, uniform sauce.

actions.description: Coat in a marinade and leave to absorb flavour. Use duration; use temperature only for "in the fridge" style instructions.
actions.visualization: Food coated in marinade in a covered bowl.

actions.description: Soak in salted water to season and keep moist.
actions.visualization: Meat submerged in salty water.

actions.description: Cover evenly with a paste, sauce or dry mixture.
actions.visualization: Food evenly covered in a coating.

actions.description: Drag through a dry coating like flour before cooking.
actions.visualization: Piece being turned in a plate of flour.

actions.description: Coat with flour, egg and breadcrumbs (cutlets, schnitzel, katsu).
actions.visualization: Piece pressed into breadcrumbs.

actions.description: Dip into a wet batter before frying (pakora, tempura, fish).
actions.visualization: Piece lifted out of batter, dripping.

actions.description: Rub seasoning into food, or rub fat into flour until crumbly.
actions.visualization: Hands rubbing spices onto meat.

actions.description: Apply a thin layer with a brush (egg wash, melted butter, oil, basting juices).
actions.visualization: Pastry brush gliding over the surface.

actions.description: Heat a pan, fat, liquid or dish (heat oil, warm milk, reheat curry). No target needed for "heat the pan".
actions.visualization: Pan on a burner, shimmering oil or gentle steam.

actions.description: Heat until liquid (butter, ghee, chocolate, cheese, jaggery).
actions.visualization: Solid turning glossy and liquid in a pan.

actions.description: General cooking when the recipe does not name a technique. Prefer a specific action (sauté, simmer, fry…) whenever one fits.
actions.visualization: Food cooking in a pan or pot on the stove.

actions.description: Cook in, or bring liquid to, a full boil.
actions.visualization: Pot with vigorous rolling bubbles.

actions.description: Cook gently in liquid just below a boil.
actions.visualization: Pot with small, lazy bubbles.

actions.description: Cook with steam over boiling water (idli, dumplings, vegetables, fish).
actions.visualization: Steamer basket with rising steam.

actions.description: Cook gently submerged in barely simmering liquid (eggs, fish, chicken, pears).
actions.visualization: Food in still, barely moving liquid.

actions.description: Briefly boil, then usually plunge into ice water (spinach, beans, almonds, tomatoes).
actions.visualization: Bright green vegetables moving from pot to ice bath.

actions.description: Partially cook by boiling before finishing another way (biryani rice, roast potatoes).
actions.visualization: Half-cooked food lifted from boiling water.

actions.description: Sear, then cook slowly, covered, in a little liquid on the stove or in the oven.
actions.visualization: Covered heavy pot with meat half-submerged in liquid.

actions.description: Cook small pieces slowly, fully submerged in liquid.
actions.visualization: Pot of chunky stew bubbling gently.

actions.description: Cook in a sealed pressure cooker. Convert "N whistles" to an approximate duration and keep the whistle count in the description.
actions.visualization: Pressure cooker on the stove releasing steam.

actions.description: Cook for hours at low heat in a slow cooker. Use heat level low/high for the cooker setting.
actions.visualization: Slow cooker with lid on.

actions.description: Cook quickly in a little fat, moving often (onions, garlic, vegetables).
actions.visualization: Pieces glistening in a pan with a little oil.

actions.description: Cook in hot fat in a pan. Prefer deep fry / shallow fry / stir fry / sauté when the recipe is specific.
actions.visualization: Food sizzling in a frying pan.

actions.description: Submerge fully in hot oil (pakora, samosa, fries, puri).
actions.visualization: Pieces bubbling in a pot of deep oil.

actions.description: Fry in a thin layer of oil, turning once (cutlets, tikki, fish).
actions.visualization: Pieces half-submerged in oil in a skillet.

actions.description: Cook fast over high heat while tossing constantly, usually in a wok.
actions.visualization: Wok with vegetables tossed over a high flame.

actions.description: Brown the surface quickly over high heat.
actions.visualization: Deep brown crust on meat in a hot pan.

actions.description: Fry whole spices and aromatics briefly in hot fat to release flavour (tadka). Also used for tempering eggs or chocolate.
actions.visualization: Spices crackling in a small pan of hot ghee.

actions.description: Cook slowly until sugars turn deep golden brown (onions, sugar).
actions.visualization: Deeply golden, jammy onions in a pan.

actions.description: Bring the oven, grill or pan up to temperature before cooking. Has no Action On target.
actions.visualization: Oven with glowing elements, dial set.

actions.description: Cook with dry heat, usually in the oven, until browned (meat, vegetables). For dry-roasting spices in a pan use Toast.
actions.visualization: Browned food on a roasting tray.

actions.description: Cook in the oven with dry heat (bread, cakes, casseroles).
actions.visualization: Dish inside a lit oven.

actions.description: Cook over direct heat on a grill, griddle pan or tandoor.
actions.visualization: Food with char marks over grill grates.

actions.description: Cook under intense top heat (broiler / oven grill).
actions.visualization: Bubbling, browned top under glowing elements.

actions.description: Blacken the outside directly over a flame (eggplant for baingan bharta, peppers, tortillas).
actions.visualization: Vegetable blackening over an open gas flame.

actions.description: Brown with dry heat and no (or little) fat (spices, nuts, rava, bread).
actions.visualization: Spices or nuts browning in a dry pan.

actions.description: Flavour or cook with smoke (smoker, or dhungar with a hot coal).
actions.visualization: Wisps of smoke over food in a covered vessel.

actions.description: Cook in an air fryer; use repeat interval for "shake every N minutes".
actions.visualization: Air-fryer basket with crisp golden food.

actions.description: Heat or cook in a microwave oven.
actions.visualization: Bowl inside a microwave.

actions.description: Simmer uncovered so liquid evaporates and flavour concentrates.
actions.visualization: Thickened, glossy sauce with a visible reduction line.

actions.description: Add liquid to a hot pan and scrape up the browned bits.
actions.visualization: Liquid hissing in a hot pan as a spoon scrapes the base.

actions.description: Make a liquid thicker, e.g. with a slurry, roux or by cooking down.
actions.visualization: Sauce coating the back of a spoon.

actions.description: Remove solids to make a liquid clear (clarified butter/ghee, consommé).
actions.visualization: Clear golden fat with milk solids at the bottom.

actions.description: Pass through a sieve or cloth to separate liquid from solids (stock, tea, paneer, purées).
actions.visualization: Liquid passing through a fine sieve.

actions.description: Remove foam, scum or fat from the surface of a liquid.
actions.visualization: Ladle skimming foam off stock.

actions.description: Pass dry ingredients through a sieve to aerate and remove lumps.
actions.visualization: Flour falling through a sieve.

actions.description: Work dough by pressing and folding until smooth and elastic.
actions.visualization: Hands pushing smooth dough on a floured counter.

actions.description: Let dough rise, or activate yeast in warm liquid.
actions.visualization: Dough risen in a covered bowl.

actions.description: Flatten with a rolling pin (roti, pastry, pasta, cookie dough). State thickness or diameter in the description.
actions.visualization: Rolling pin flattening dough into a circle.

actions.description: Form into shapes (balls, patties, loaves, dumplings, koftas).
actions.visualization: Evenly shaped balls or patties on a tray.

actions.description: Coat a pan or tray with fat, or line it with paper. The ingredient is the fat used, if any.
actions.visualization: Tin coated with butter or lined with parchment.

actions.description: Add a final topping for flavour and looks (chopped coriander, fried onions, sesame).
actions.visualization: Finished dish with fresh garnish on top.

actions.description: Pour a thin stream over the top (oil, cream, honey, sauce).
actions.visualization: Thin ribbon of liquid over the dish.

actions.description: Coat with a shiny layer (sugar glaze, reduced sauce, jam).
actions.visualization: Glossy coating catching the light.

actions.description: Scatter a light, even layer of a dry ingredient (icing sugar, cocoa, chaat masala, cheese).
actions.visualization: Fine powder falling through a small sieve.

actions.description: Arrange food on the serving plate or platter.
actions.visualization: Neatly plated food on a clean plate.

actions.description: Serve the finished dish; put accompaniments and "hot/chilled" in the description.
actions.visualization: Finished dish served at the table.

actions.description: Preserve or flavour in vinegar, brine or spiced oil.
actions.visualization: Jar of vegetables in pickling liquid.

actions.description: Leave to ferment (idli/dosa batter, yogurt, kimchi, sourdough).
actions.visualization: Bubbly, risen batter in a covered container.

actions.description: Remove moisture: pat dry with paper towel, air-dry, sun-dry or dehydrate.
actions.visualization: Food patted with paper towels or spread out to dry.

actions.description: Preserve with salt, sugar or nitrates (gravlax, bacon).
actions.visualization: Fish covered in a salt and sugar mix.

actions.description: Seal in sterilised jars for storage (jams, chutneys, confit).
actions.visualization: Sealed glass jars on a counter.

actions.description: Pause for a period without doing anything.
actions.visualization: Timer beside the resting dish.

actions.description: Leave food undisturbed so it relaxes, sets or redistributes juices (dough, meat, batter).
actions.visualization: Covered dough or meat resting on a board.

actions.description: Keep in the refrigerator or an ice bath to cool or set.
actions.visualization: Covered bowl on a refrigerator shelf.

actions.description: Let food come down in temperature, usually to room temperature.
actions.visualization: Tray on a wire rack with faint steam.

actions.description: Freeze until solid or firm.
actions.visualization: Frosted container in a freezer.

actions.description: Bring frozen food back to a workable state.
actions.visualization: Frozen food with condensation on a plate.

actions.description: Only when no catalog action can represent the operation. Always give a customActionName.

flameLevels.label: Off
flameLevels.description: Heat switched off — residual heat only.

flameLevels.label: Very Low
flameLevels.description: Barest flame; keeps warm, melts gently, slow-cooks.

flameLevels.label: Low
flameLevels.description: Gentle heat for simmering and slow cooking.

flameLevels.label: Very High
flameLevels.description: Maximum heat — wok hei, hard sear.

temperatureContexts.label: Oven Temperature
temperatureContexts.description: Air temperature of the oven, smoker or air fryer.

temperatureContexts.label: Liquid Temperature
temperatureContexts.description: Temperature of the cooking or soaking liquid.

temperatureContexts.label: Surface Temperature
temperatureContexts.description: Temperature of the pan, griddle or grill surface.

temperatureContexts.label: Holding Temperature
temperatureContexts.description: Surrounding temperature (fridge, freezer, warm place, room temperature).
